description: Adds a tag to a question bank, by tagName or tagId from riddle_tag_list - exactly one of the two, as riddle_tag_add does. Question bank tags and Riddle tags are ONE set per project, not two: the same tag applies to banks and Riddles and has the same id in both, which is why the ids come from riddle_tag_list. Reuses the project's tag of that name or creates it, and re-tagging changes nothing. question_bank_tag_remove takes it off again. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to tag.

tagId.description: The ID of an existing tag, as returned by riddle_tag_list. Pass either this or tagName.

tagName.description: The name of the tag. The project's tag of that name is reused, or created if there is none yet. Pass either this or tagId.

name: question_bank_tag_add
